roasts.name: Highveld Sunrise
roasts.notes: Bright and citrus-forward with a caramel finish. Our lightest roast, and the one to skip if you take your coffee with a lot of milk.

roasts.name: Midnight Kraal
roasts.notes: Bold and smoky, with dark chocolate carrying through into the finish. Holds up well in a moka pot or French press.

roasts.name: Karoo Gold
roasts.notes: Smooth and nutty with a honey finish that lingers. The one we hand people who say they don't really like coffee.
